Expected Result: mutable untrusted and artifact-mismatched image references are denied

Check Title: Runtime evidence excludes raw sensitive provider content
Threat Scenarios: CONTAINER-RUNTIME-POST-ADMISSION-BEHAVIOR: A compromised or malicious workload starts unexpected processes modifies protected files escalates privileges crosses runtime boundaries communicates with denied destinations or exhausts resources after admission.; CONTAINER-RUNTIME-IDENTITY-CONFUSION: A runtime event is attributed to the wrong workload or to a mutable image identity and causes incorrect triage or response.; CONTAINER-RUNTIME-TELEMETRY-FAIL-OPEN: Sensor outage event drop rule removal forwarding failure or malformed input is interpreted as an event-free clean result.; CONTAINER-RUNTIME-UNSAFE-RESPONSE: A detection triggers destructive action without independent authorization or leaks sensitive raw command and payload content into evidence.
Threat Actor or Source: log reader compromised observability account or accidental disclosure through raw runtime telemetry
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: command lines environment values file content or packet payload expose credentials personal data or protected code in evidence
Why This Check Is Required: detection evidence must support triage without creating a second sensitive-data repository
Required State: evidence contains only check provider rule category event decision metadata and excludes raw command arguments files payloads and credentials
Verification Method: validate evidence allowlist and prove provider raw output markers never reach verifier output
Expected Result: forbidden fields are rejected and synthetic sensitive markers are absent
Required Evidence: sanitized evidence policy result
